title: Ready-Then-Queue Publication and Lane-State Decoupling
owner_directive: Replace the failing three-lane FIFO/held-turn system with independent lane execution plus late-binding ready-candidate integration. The shared publication mechanism is for merging ready immutable candidates only, not for doing implementation, validation, closeout or release work. Remove manual release as a queue dependency and decouple release/deployment from source integration.
reproduced_failures: Recent completed checkpoints required repeated owner intervention: MSAS-03 recorded 5 Continue turns and 2 stall nudges; MSAS-01 recorded 4 Continue turns; MRCS-01 and MVPS-10 each required repeated owner execution commands.

Schema-2.1 FIFO activates before RED/GREEN preparation and validation; recent MSAS-03 application history held the publication turn while causal RED, GREEN candidate construction and Linux validation were performed.
AIOC coordination history required queued-reservation cancellation/reordering, active-reservation duplicate repair, and recovery-release of an already merged MVPS-10 closeout.
Governed-start, implementation publication, checkpoint/CURRENT closeout and release all compete for protected AIOC main, turning administrative state changes into repository-wide serialization.
Release/closeout currently depends on the originating executor surviving after durable merge; a stalled conversation can require another executor to recover the publication turn.

During OPS3-10 itself, this chat stopped immediately after a batched read of the three selected lane checkpoints with no blocker or terminal response. The queue was not held; execution simply ceased, proving executor/session continuity must not be a project dependency.
repair_scope: Introduce ready-candidate publication state: candidates enter publication order only after an immutable head exists and prequeue validation is green.

Remove active holder/turn-base work windows from the normal publication path; no implementation, RED/GREEN construction, full tranche validation or closeout work occurs while owning a shared publication lock.
Serialize only the atomic integration/merge decision. A candidate is terminal from durable repository evidence; no separate release operation is required.
Add independent durable lane-state refs/surfaces for msas, mrcs and mvps so lane execution/progress updates do not contend on protected AIOC main.
Keep operations/CURRENT.json as the small global selector/system-policy aggregate rather than the high-frequency lane execution log.
Separate source integration from build/release/deployment status so a slow or failed release cannot block source publication.
Add regression tests for no pre-ready reservation, no holder/release lifecycle, crash safety, lane-state isolation, ready-candidate ordering and drift-sensitive integration checks.
Preserve MSAS-04, MRCS-03 and MVPS-12 selected_not_started throughout the repair.

Add executor/session interruption discipline: no silent waiting or open-ended polling, durable lane-state receipts after material side effects, and exact resume from the last receipt after a chat/tool/runtime abort.

last_material_progress.evidence: OPS3-10 implementation PR 1447 passed final held-turn exact-head run 35449973250 and merged as ded58c33932556b60187e6299ff1a32684ea6dcc; legacy lease ref was retired/free at 535ac2f9c425aca6b817a21cb24f7f7a65ffc095; new lane-state and READY queue refs are seeded.

stop_reason.evidence: Ready-then-queue publication, isolated lane execution state, executor interruption recovery discipline and legacy lease retirement are implemented and validated; this closeout clears the temporary product-start freeze.

execution_conformance.note: OPS3-10 product/operations results are valid, but execution required the original approval plus two owner restarts after session stalls. The second observed stall occurred after a batched checkpoint read with no legitimate blocker; the redesign makes future session continuity non-blocking.

next_action: OPS3-10 is closed. Resume MSAS-04, MRCS-03 or MVPS-12 only when explicitly requested; start/resume on that lane's independent execution-state ref and publish only immutable green READY candidates.

acceptance_evidence.new_publication_model: READY candidates only; no holder, turn_base, release, or recovery-release
acceptance_evidence.executor_stall_recovery: durable lane-state receipts plus fresh evidence resume; no silent waiting/polling
